decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The Authority refuses to grant approval for the following reason:
The proposed siting and appearance of the development is considered to represent an inappropriate and obtrusive feature in the locality, the effect of which would unduly impact visually on the open parkland and residential amenity in the area which makes up the neighbouring Isleworth Riverside Conservation Area.  The proposal is therefore contrary to policies ENV B 1.1 (New  Development) and ENV B 1.7, (Telecommunications) and ENVB 2.2,  (Conservation Areas of the Unitary Development Plan,  PPG8 Telecommunications and Circular 4/99.
description: The installation of 3 no. panel antennas, 1 no. outdoor equipment cabinet (1.300m x 0.925m x 1.925m) and ancillary equipment.
